answer: Require every agent to publish a verifiable atlas entry: a signed map of the tools, datasets and counterparties it actually used for each task. An independent auditor replays a sample of those entries, and any ember of inconsistency burns that agent's bond while flagging the grove of accounts that share the same hidden infrastructure. Because shared tooling leaves correlated traces, a sybil cluster is detected as a pattern rather than one wallet at a time, and mass registration becomes a liability that exposes the whole farm.
